fixes.explanation: Family matters a lot, friend, and verse 4 even talks about a husband and wife. But verse 8 doesn't hand out praise by who your people are. It says a man is praised "…according to his wisdom…" Praise follows how a person thinks, and the verse adds that "…a twisted mind is despised."

Power might sound like what counselors want. But notice verse 20 is talking about hearts, not rank. Deceit is in the hearts of those who devise evil, while the counselors of peace "have joy." I think the verse is showing what each person carries around inside, and a big title isn't part of it.

Boldness can be a good thing, but verse 22 doesn't name it. Lying lips are "…detestable to the LORD…" and the other side is "…those who deal faithfully are His delight." Dealing faithfully is the opposite of lying, so the point isn't how loud you are. The point is whether you're true.
